name: Water Polo Ball (Size 5)
summary: 18 spherical strips in six cube-face groups of three. Twelve yellow main panels and six blue centre strips, recessed channels and a deep baked rubber-grip normal map.
description: 18 spherical strips in six cube-face groups of three. Twelve yellow main panels and six blue centre strips, recessed channels and a deep baked rubber-grip normal map.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python spherical panel geometry and Cycles-baked 3D Voronoi normal map; no external assets, logos or text.

display.origin: Floor contact point under the ball centre; lowest actual vertex at Z=0

accuracy_notes: The straight cube-projected strip layout is original and generic. Deep grip is normal-map relief only; water absorption, wet sheen and swimming physics are not simulated. Fine grain is baked normal detail only; it does not alter the silhouette. Panel rims are explicit geometry over a recessed spherical bed. No internal bladder, valve, inflation, mass, bounce or physics. Diameter tolerance of 0.8 mm accounts for finite tessellation and rounded panel edges; the actual lowest vertex is translated to Z=0.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry, materials and baked texture; no external models, fonts, images or logos.
